key_insight: Combining greedy EV scheduling with TD3 energy dispatch reduced service delays, energy costs, and carbon emissions most among the evaluated configurations.
engineering_relevance: The approach coordinates limited chargers, solar generation, battery storage, and grid exchange for cost- and carbon-aware charging-station operation.
method: Use a solver-free greedy heuristic to assign EVs based on service-delay reductions.
Use TD3 reinforcement learning to control battery operation while meeting charging demand.
Account for PV and battery exports through export revenue and carbon credits.
evidence_signal: Year-long simulation case studies found SFGH–TD3 achieved the lowest accumulated delay, cost, and emissions among the evaluated heuristic and multi-agent DRL configurations.
watch_item: Simulation results do not establish real-world performance, which may depend on tariffs, carbon-credit rules, and operating conditions.
paper_title: Electric Vehicle Scheduling and Carbon-Aware Energy Dispatch for Charging Stations
